_comment: OpenCode Go gateway. One API key reaches three wires; the catalog protocol hint (the Model's AI SDK package on models.dev) routes the Messages and Responses Models (Grok 4.7 on Responses live low-effort smoke verified), a rule routes the Messages Models the catalog names no package for, and every other Model speaks Chat Completions. Every wire carries the x-opencode-session prompt-cache affinity header (Adapter code). Chat replays readable reasoning_content only (OpenCode's own client never replays reasoning_details) and gives every historical Tool Call a reasoning_content carrier, empty when the call had no readable Reasoning: DeepSeek's thinking mode rejects a Tool Call without it. Responses is stateless (store false), takes only max_output_tokens (max_tokens maps onto it) and top_p, and structured output on every Model; its default ladder has no none rung because the gateway rejected an explicit none (live 2026-08-25), so only a Model whose ladder lists none sends it. Models that cannot stop reasoning get their cheapest rung for none. Replay scope is full_history, also where an upstream preserved-thinking contract is stronger than a particular gateway measurement; only Qwen replays tool_turns. GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools outside the request's Tool list, so Tools announced mid-Session are listed there.

rules.note: The GPT Models (gpt-5.6-luna, gpt-6-luna) answer top_p with HTTP 400 {"model": ...}, which names no parameter, so it cannot be learned; Grok and Muse Spark accept it (live 2026-10-03).
The gateway serves these MiniMax and Qwen Models on Anthropic Messages (/messages), but the catalog names no package for them.
Hy and Kimi answer with readable reasoning plus reasoning_details; their history still replays reasoning_content.

These Models answer with readable reasoning_content; the listing carries no response-field hint for most of them. deepseek-flash is the gateway alias of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, so both ids resolve alike.
DeepSeek's thinking switch is independent of its effort ladder: thinking stays enabled by default and with an effort; none disables it and sends no effort.
Binary thinking.type switch, enabled by default (MiMo V2.6 verified 2026-09-22).
Kimi K2.6 switches thinking on or off and keeps every earlier thinking turn (keep all) while enabled.
Kimi K2.7 Code always thinks: the request always enables thinking and sends no effort.
These Models always reason; none asks for the cheapest rung (low) instead of the higher default.

Go forwards Messages to Anthropic, where Claude Haiku 5.5 removed sampling parameters (catalog supports_temperature false in resources/wire/anthropic.json); temperature answers HTTP 400 "`temperature` is deprecated for this model" (live 2026-10-08), so they are never sent.
GLM 5.3 Flash drops calls to Tools that are not in the request's Tool list.

The gateway bills historical answer-turn Reasoning of every Qwen Model (verify_wire_profile replay check, live 2026-10-03). Qwen's own chat template keeps earlier Reasoning only with preserve_thinking, so answer turns drop it and Tool Call turns keep it.
